observations: The dense filled spherical canopy envelope from diagnostic1 has been removed. Final foliage follows unequal branch sprays with breaks, different spans and irregular tops.
Two trial background broadleaf trees were withdrawn; the original 29 garden and 16 southern broadleaf root positions remain, with four inferred conifers added.
Final leaf count lies between the overfilled first and overthinned second trials. Open east-front crowns retain visible branches.
Southern avenue combines broadleaf spreading crowns and upright narrow conifers; trunks remain above the grass planting strip, with the central lawn open.
Top and overall show preserved plaza, planters, east corridor, garden paths, garage roofs and low shrubs.
No solid ball crown surfaces or artificial opaque cones were used. Thin leaf meshes and deliberately overlapping branches form the new trees.
remaining_limits: This is a procedural visual revision, not a measured or individual-tree replica; branch detail and exact species remain inferred.
The approximate photo cameras do not reproduce all photo foreground framing and depth.
Branch subdivision, bark appearance and leaf silhouettes remain simplified; the result is submitted for visual review, not declared a photorealistic match.
Previously accepted low shrubs and their large foreground leaf blades were protected and not changed in this tree-only iteration.
Garage sign sizing/export and campus webpage switching remain separate work.
